svg.text: Optics bench wiring: Feather ESP32 V2, 4x Adafruit TMC2209, Quarton laser, ADS1115 and photodiodes
Matches firmware/optics_bench/config.h. Same-named labels are connected. All grounds (12 V supply, Feather, every breakout) are tied together.
3V3 rail (drivers, MS straps, laser, ADC, TIAs)
STEMMA QT port = 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL
Adafruit TMC2209 breakout (6121). Mirror M1, X adjuster
Adafruit TMC2209 breakout (6121). Mirror M1, Y adjuster
Adafruit TMC2209 breakout (6121). Mirror M2, X adjuster
Adafruit TMC2209 breakout (6121). Mirror M2, Y adjuster
+ to every VMotor, - to every GND
Quarton VLM-635-32 LPT laser (635 nm, < 1 mW)
3-6 V, < 40 mA; TTL high = on (1-20 mA input), up to 10 kHz
Check the wire colours against the module's label (usually red +V, black GND).
- MS1/MS2 have no pull resistors on the breakout: tie each one
to 3V3 or GND to set that driver's UART address.
- Leave the SPREAD solder jumper open (StealthChop).
- The current pot does nothing: the firmware sets current over UART.
- EN is pulled low on the breakout, so each driver is enabled until
the firmware boots and drives EN high.
- The drivers only answer on UART once 12 V is on.
- Never connect or disconnect a motor while 12 V is on.
- Coil pairs: find the two wires with a few ohms between them
(one coil) and put them on 1A/1B, the other pair on 2A/2B.
I2C address 0x48. A STEMMA QT cable to the Feather
carries 3V3, GND, SDA and SCL in one plug.
BPW34 + MCP6002 (DIP-8, half A used) on a small board right behind the diode
Pin 8 VDD to 3V3, pin 4 to GND, 100 nF across pins 8 and 4 at the chip.
Unused half B: pin 5 to GND, pin 6 to pin 7. Vout = I_photo x Rf (0 V dark, up)
BPW34 + MCP6002 (DIP-8, half A used) on a small board right behind the diode
Pin 8 VDD to 3V3, pin 4 to GND, 100 nF across pins 8 and 4 at the chip.
Unused half B: pin 5 to GND, pin 6 to pin 7. Vout = I_photo x Rf (0 V dark, up)
- Cathode to pin 2, anode to GND (zero bias).
The output then rises from 0 V with light.
- To find the anode: in room light a meter on
DC volts reads about +0.3 V with the red
- Keep diode leads under 10 mm; run a twisted
- 47 kOhm puts 3.3 V at 70 uA (about 175 uW).
Fit a smaller Rf if a channel saturates and
set PD_REF/OUT_TIA_OHMS in config.h to match.
- Rf x Cf = 47 us, a 3.4 kHz bandwidth.
